objective: A support-free, all-printable hand-cranked desk automaton called Orbit Gobbler: a cheerful space creature swallows a moon, carries it through a clearly visible orbit, and pops it back out in a satisfying loop, with no purchased hardware.
public_summary: An all-printable hand-cranked desktop automaton in which a geared carrier guides a captive moon through a visible orbit and back through a fixed C-shaped mouth every two crank turns.
